suppress.notes: DEF-137: CVE-2025-7962 affects Jakarta Mail SMTP message handling. ODC mapped it to the separate angus-activation artifact; this application does not include Jakarta Mail.

DEF-137: these records affect the GlassFish server or its administration console. ODC mapped the standalone JAXB implementation to GlassFish; the application is Spring Boot with embedded Tomcat and contains no GlassFish runtime or administration application.

DEF-137: CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization in Kotlin build-cache metadata. These stdlib jars are runtime transitives of the Aliyun credential client and do not provide or consume Kotlin compiler or build-cache metadata in this Maven-built application.
DEF-137: CVE-2020-29582 affects Kotlin versions before 1.4.21. ODC associated it with kotlin-stdlib-common 1.9.10, which is outside the affected version range.

DEF-137: CVE-2026-49844 requires JsonTemplateLayout (or another MapMessage JSON layout) plus an attacker-controlled non-finite MapMessage value. The application uses SLF4J with Logback and has no MapMessage or JsonTemplateLayout use.
DEF-137: CVE-2026-54291 is limited to channelBinding=require. The approved preproduction JDBC URL enforces sslmode=verify-full and does not enable channelBinding=require.

DEF-137: these embedded-Tomcat records require FFM CRL configuration, effective web.xml logging, RewriteValve, cluster EncryptInterceptor, default-servlet container constraints, or the Tomcat example application. None is configured or packaged; authorization is enforced by the Spring Security filter chain. Reassess before enabling any listed feature.
